about: The C and C++ sources of freedom-colibrid's native Colibri build, by tree, with their licenses (design 0014, Licenses). scripts/colibri-license-gate.py fails on a tree in the build that isn't listed here, on a compiled source or listed header whose SPDX identifier isn't in its tree's `spdx`, on a third party's tree whose license file isn't its `license`, and on PolyForm anywhere except `polyform_mentions`.

components.name: Colibri Stateless
components.note: src/server/ is PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 or commercial; the build compiles and includes none of it, nor src/chains/eth/server/ or the prover

components.name: Colibri's CMake-generated headers (verifiers.h, the trusted setup)
libs/crypto (trezor-crypto, with mbed TLS's RIPEMD-160)
components.note: MIT, except ripemd160.c, Apache-2.0 (Copyright ARM Limited)

components.name: blst
components.note: compiled by its own build script, outside CMake's compile commands: the gate checks its tree's LICENSE

components.name: evmone
components.note: linked because 3.0.3 doesn't build without the call verifier (COL-2); no served operation reaches it

polyform_mentions.why: MIT; c4_print_version prints the server's license text, and only the server and the CLIs call it (0014, Licenses)
